text: This was just a marketing name that I gave a program that I designed, but it wasn't a specific group or anything like that. It was just a good, solid program that I wrote for more like weekend warriors: people that wanted to be athletic, but they didn't need to compete in any sport. These are non-competitive, all-around athletic adults. Youth can be there too, and kids, but just non-competitive athletics or training with a good mix of everything. It's just good health all around and just having a body that performs well.
